ambiguities_or_notes: All seven numbered business points, the postscript, fourth-page address/instruction, three source page markers, eleven embedded editorial-note list items, and eight Markdown footnote definitions are represented.

Official volume 59 confirms that the Markdown has lost printed notes 4, 7, and 8 and the marker for note 7. Consistent with the established Volume 59 policy used in P005.09, the English does not silently import omitted Soviet apparatus; bare numerals 4 and 8 remain visible and the missing marker 7 is documented only in QA.
запрещение on the estate is rendered restriction rather than a modern mortgage lien term that would narrow the imperial legal concept.
векселя are promissory notes; перезалог is remortgaging; ревизия is the numbered imperial Revision census and is capitalized accordingly.
прибавочные души is retained as additional souls, preserving the period fiscal/serf-count term rather than euphemizing it.
Ералаш is retained as the card game Yeralash; the French pour lui faire la cour is translated in italics as to pay court to him, while the absent printed gloss is not imported.
подписавшись под наши руки / подписаться под руки is rendered signing in our names, with the postscript preserving Petr’s warning that doing so is dangerous.

The embedded Sergei letter’s opaque Romani forms shukr, pashukr, trebitsy, na lovy are transliterated because the source editorial note explicitly says they could not be translated; opaque frizovaya is likewise left transliterated rather than guessed.
